hooks.command: printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" > "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.plugin-data-dir"; diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/running-coach/requirements.txt" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/requirements.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (python3 -m venv "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" && "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv/bin/pip" install -q -r "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/running-coach/requirements.txt" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/running-coach/requirements.txt" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/requirements.txt") || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/requirements.txt"
